venture.name: HearHere
venture.description: An app that streams the lecturer's voice to the phone of a student with hearing loss.

sessions: Students with hearing loss will buy it. I interviewed 6 of them and all 6 said they want it.
The disability services office already pays for note-takers.
good_eir: Separates the user (the student), the buyer (perhaps the disability services office) and the payer (the university budget, a state program, insurance?). Grades '6 of 6 said they want it' as what people said (rung 3), not buying. Asks who decides and who pays, and suggests talking to the office.
